Bob Macpherson’s

This is my first attempt at writing in ABC notation. I read about this tune on The Session under the recording details by Ceolbeg - https://thesession.org/recordings/3017. Raked around the internet and found the tune in “Donald Sutherland’s Collection of Highland Bagpipe Music” as an e-book download available here: https://pipingpressshop.com/products/donald-sutherland-collection for the “princely sum” of £1.50!

I tried to get rid of the slurs because there are none in Sutherland’s book to no avail! I hope it’s all okay. Perhaps someone will point out any mistakes and how to correct them.

Re: Bob Macpherson’s

Bob, if you send Jeremy (the Boss!) a message from the link on this page:

https://thesession.org/users/1

He can delete the settings for you.

When you’re typesetting bagpipe music with ABC, you can use the “special” key signatures of K:HP or K:Hp - they remove all the wierd slurs and typeset the gracenotes correctly. The first displays no key signature as normal with bagpipe music, and the second inserts a “mixolydian” signature of two sharps and a G natural.

On here as Kenny says generally better to leave the gracenotes out unless there’s a good reason to, but if you do want to add them you can put [K:HP] with the square brackets as your first line before your ABC text and that will force the key signature to do what you want.
